decisions.rationale: The profile reports duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across row_count 3322, so no dedupe step is needed.
tailnum has distinct_count 3322 equal to row_count 3322 with null_rate 0.0, so one row per aircraft tail number is the defensible grain.

purpose: silver_nyc_planes is the cleaned aircraft reference table derived from bronze.nyc_planes, providing one row per tail number with manufacturer, model, type, engine configuration, seat count, and manufacture year for joining to flight-level fact tables.
usage: Join on tailnum, the declared grain and unique key (3322 distinct values across 3322 rows). Numeric attributes (year_manufactured, engines, seats, speed) are cast to INTEGER from decimal landings. Consumers should expect nulls in year_manufactured (about 2.1% of rows) and treat speed as effectively unavailable, since it is populated for fewer than 1% of rows.
limitations: The speed column is sparsely populated (null_rate 0.993076) and is retained as-is with no imputation; it should not be used for analysis without acknowledging the coverage gap. year_manufactured carries 70 nulls that were not resolved. Airbyte capture columns were dropped, so lineage back to the raw extraction record requires the bronze table. No deduplication was applied because the profile showed duplicate_row_rate 0.0.
